1. (Currently Amended) A humeral implant comprising a first humeral surface component removably attached to a second stem component, wherein said first humeral surface component is configured for connection to said second stem component by a connection mechanism selected from the group consisting of a morse taper and a screw.

2. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first humeral surface component is a humeral surface and said second stem component is a removably attached stem.

3. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature, and wherein said humeral surface component is comprised of a smooth articulating surface.

20. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 2 wherein said attachable stem component has a variable length, wherein said stem component is adapted to extend from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus. 

21. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 20 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem component. 

22. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem component by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper, and a screw. 

29. (Currently Amended) A humerus bone implant comprising a modular implant with a humeral surface component and a stem, wherein said stem is adapted to be anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of said humerus bone.
